protocol: Fit-only diagnostic frozen during the main run before audit and evaluation results. Replay the same first-local-call prefix using (1) actual annotated region clipped to image with unchanged question-based tool attribute and (2) same reference region with the annotation's attribute. Compare paired automatic answer correctness to the already computed before and predicted-region outputs, with exactly the same answer and judge prompts. Exclude missing or degenerate reference coordinates or missing attribute. No training or evaluation use of these privileged controls. No changes to the main run.
